text:
```yaml
name: Claude Code Review

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, ready_for_review, reopened]

jobs:
  claude_review:
    if: ${{ !github.event.pull_request.draft && github.actor != 'dependabot[bot]' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    concurrency:
      group: claude-review-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
      cancel-in-progress: true
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Run Claude review
        uses: anthropic/claude@v1
        env:
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
        with:
          prompt_file: .cursor/commands/review-pr.md
          tools: cargo,yarn,git,gh
          comment_mode: sticky
          comment_title: Claude Review
          comment_id: claude-review
```
